newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close firm, outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close firm, outlook positive.

text.p: 1745 GMT - Shares closed firmer, boosted by the strength of the dollar and gains in leading European centres.
*Traders said that the tone should continue positive on Thursday as the mood remains upbeat abroad.
*"I think that the uptrend will continue tomorrow. The mood abroad is very positive," said one trader.
*Portugal Telecom, Portucel Industrial and Sonae Investmentos were the stars of the session.

*Telecom and Portucel were helped by the dollar but Sonae Investimentos was also benefitting from investor enthusiasm for the recent split in which Sonae's industrial interests were placed in a separate holding. Traders said that the move had increased the company's transparency.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index rose 0.8 percent to 6,153.54, with the March futures gaining by a similar amount.
